question: Should per-agent dashboard grouping/collapse be accepted as a bundled dashboard plugin feature after the Wave 1 workspace contracts settle, and should collapse state be transient or persisted?
rationale: This is a new Control UI product behavior layered on an unmerged dashboard architecture, so automation cannot safely choose the roadmap sequencing, storage semantics, or shared/private visibility boundary.

options.title: Stage After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as a later dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap
options.body: Treat this as a subtask of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and avoid a separate implementation decision until the larger dashboard roadmap is sequenced.

options.title: Defer Agent Grouping
options.body: Keep the initial dashboard model flat and revisit per-agent grouping only after real multi-agent dashboard usage proves the need.

recommendation.title: Stage After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as a later dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and dashboard product boundary points to his recent area work.
